item.title: Microservices Architecture & Distributed System Design Patterns
item.author: ThanhLD
item.description: Monolith vs Microservices Architecture Monolithic Architecture Pros: - Simpler to develop and deploy: Single codebase, fewer moving parts. - Easier testing: End-to-end tests are straightforward. - Lower operational overhead: One unit to manage and deploy. Cons: Limited scalability: Scaling requires scaling the entire app. - Harder to maintain: As the app grows, managing the codebase becomes difficult. - Tight coupling: Changes in one part can affect the entire system. Microservices Architecture Pros: - Independent scalability: Scale each service based on need.
